quote: We employ GPT-4o (OpenAI and other authors, 2024) to classify two sets of NLP4SG papers—those within the ACL Anthology (including both ACL and ACL-ADJACENT venues) and those outside of it (EXTERNAL)—into one of the 17 SDGs.

Three authors with backgrounds in NLP annotated 200 randomly selected papers published by an ACL author at a non-ACL venue for their association with social good, as defined by association with UN SDGs.
guideline: Annotation instructions are provided in Appendix B and results in Table 3.
